## Artifact and privacy contract

- Tools exposing `outputPath` or result middleware preserve full evidence in local artifacts while summaries stay compact.
- Saved artifacts are classified as local raw evidence under `.pi/browser-artifacts/`; cleanup is manual and local-only.
- `browser_artifact` redacts cookie/token/authorization/body/postData/websocket payload values by default; `redact:false` is an explicit local raw-evidence read.
- WebSecurity tools use bounded local artifacts and shared distillation helpers; raw evidence stays local.
- Lifecycle fixture failure evidence is written to `.pi/browser-artifacts/lifecycle-fixture-failure.json` with cookie/token/authorization/body/postData-style fields redacted by key.
